two-top/b978183:
The standing question was whether the two builds should simply be the
same game. They should: ARCHITECTURE.md line 7 has said "Same Rust
codebase across all three" since the beginning. Reviewing the four gaps
the last commit filed under "on purpose", three were backlog wearing a
principle's coat.

TURN on the web. The claim was that a browser cannot block a thread on
ureq — true, and irrelevant: it can fetch. fetch_ice_web feeds the same
channel finish_ice_fetch already polls, and that poll's existing budget
bounds the request (a fetch has no timeout of its own). A browser duel
can now relay instead of failing outright on a carrier NAT. This is the
only gap in the set where a match did not merely feel different, it did
not connect.

Tapes, and therefore REPLAYS, the rivalry rings, the shade and
.attest.json. "A page cannot write a file" conflated two things. A tape
is ~14 KB (8 bytes a frame); a 5 MB localStorage budget holds ~270.
shared_dir now returns a virtual root on the web, and two new seams —
read_bytes and list_dir — back it, so every tape surface runs the same
code path as the APK. Binary rides base64 behind a marker; JSON stays
plain text so the documents remain readable in devtools. web_key keys
off the whole subpath now, which is what makes a directory listable.

SHARE. post_tape_web is the same POST over fetch. Where no drop is baked
the browser's button becomes SAVE TAPE — a download, which is the honest
answer to the one thing a page truly cannot do: put a file in someone's
Files app unprompted. It asks instead. A .bmrg plays anywhere, so that
is also how a browser player swaps tapes with a friend.

The render tier stopped being a compile-time guess. The previous fix
moved the browser onto the Android arm: right for a phone, wrong for a
laptop. The question — how much GPU is there — was being answered by the
target triple. There is now a capability module: touch_primary() asks
CSS (pointer: coarse), and one camera decides its glow from that at
startu
noodles/b9cc586:
A slot is now a scale degree or {pcs} (DECISIONS D13), and one
resolver - harmonyChord - turns either into the CHORDS record shape,
so playback, previews, minis, and the editor never branch on which
kind they hold. The circle's armed capture becomes the chromatic
writer: a clean tap on an out-of-sector wedge stores the visit. The
borrowed entry transposes with key changes alongside bass and melody
(a bVI stays a bVI), spells by its function rather than the home
signature's side (Ab in C, never G#), and wears one off-palette
violet in every chord markup - which now also tints each roman
numeral with its function hue, in the session minis, the
arrangement minis, and the editor slots alike. The smoke gate
punches a borrowed chord and asserts the {pcs} entry lands.
noodles/b9fbccf:
Spend the per-track tape retirement on the bus: SAT_WET 0.42 to 0.50,
SAT_DRIVE_DB 12 to 14, SAT_ASYM 0.35 to 0.40. All three are level-neutral
by construction (the drive comes back off after the blend; the curve keeps
unity slope at the origin), so the change buys harmonics, not loudness.

2-3 dB at -12, LUFS -10.72 to -10.80, small-signal gain 15.51 dB on both
sides, worst dice true peak -0.27 dBTP — the true-peak headroom design
holds. Drive alone measured near-flat at program level (the tanh is
already deep there), which is why the wet ratio carries the character.
